requirements.title: PARITY argument restrictions
requirements.definition: MASK shall be a logical array, and DIM shall be an integer scalar with value in the range one through the rank of MASK.

pending.PARITY-MASK-logical-array: Positive source controls call PARITY with rank-one and rank-two logical MASK arrays; source-control mutations use a scalar MASK and a nonlogical array with no diagnostic facet.
pending.PARITY-DIM-integer-scalar-in-rank-range: Positive controls use DIM=1 and DIM=2 for a rank-two MASK; source-control mutations use DIM=0, DIM=3, and a rank-one DIM array with no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: PARITY result characteristics
requirements.definition: The PARITY result is logical with the same kind as MASK, scalar with DIM absent, and otherwise rank n minus one with the shape of MASK excluding dimension DIM.

pending.PARITY-result-logical-same-kind: Use default logical and a guarded nondefault logical kind MASK, assert KIND(result) follows MASK and mutate MASK kind in the expected expression.
pending.PARITY-result-scalar-without-DIM: Call PARITY on a rank-two MASK without DIM and assign to a scalar initialized to the opposite logical value; assert scalar truth from the value facet.
pending.PARITY-result-rank-and-shape-with-DIM: Call PARITY on a 2-by-3 MASK with DIM=1 and DIM=2; assert SHAPE results [3] and [2], paired with element values so shape is not the only observation.

requirements.title: PARITY result value is odd logical parity
requirements.definition: PARITY without DIM is true exactly for an odd number of true MASK elements, PARITY of a rank-one MASK with DIM equals PARITY of the whole MASK, and higher-rank DIM results apply PARITY to each section along DIM.

pending.PARITY-odd-number-true-elements: Use rank-one logical arrays with one, two, and three true values plus an all-false companion; initialize results to opposite sentinels and mutate .NEQV. to .EQV. or change one MASK element. Also evaluate PARITY on a zero-size logical array with the scalar target prefilled true and assert false, paired with a one-element true array asserting true.
pending.PARITY-rank-one-DIM-equals-whole: Use a rank-one MASK with three true values and assert PARITY(MASK,DIM=1) equals the no-DIM result; companion with two true values prevents a constant true oracle.
pending.PARITY-DIM-section-values: Use a 2-by-3 MASK whose column parities are false,false,true and row parities are false,true; assert both DIM results and mutate DIM or transpose the expected vector. Also use a zero-extent dimension producing DIM sections with no true elements; prefill the result array true and assert every section result is false, paired with a same-rank companion containing an odd-count section that asserts true.
